Drugs.com found no drug-drug interaction between melatonin and Folate Forte (a multivitamin). It did flag 5 warnings, and all of them apply to melatonin alone.

- **Interactions:** Major (0), moderate (0), minor (0) and duplication (0). Drugs.com adds that no interactions found doesn't guarantee none exist, so check with a healthcare provider.
- **Food/lifestyle (1, moderate):** Melatonin interacts with food or lifestyle factors. The page showed only the heading, not the detail, so I can't say which factor it means.
- **Disease (4):** Melatonin may matter if you have depression, urinary retention, liver disease, or glaucoma/intraocular hypertension. The details weren't shown on the page either.

Everything above is from the Drugs.com Interaction Checker report: https://www.drugs.com/interactions-check.php?drug_list=1661-20176%2C1548-0
